changelog:
- Initial release of the doctorclaw-project-status skill.
- Compiles daily project status boards from tasks, calendar events, and team updates.
- Supports multiple project management tools (Todoist, Asana, Notion, Trello, Linear, CSV) as data sources.
- Provides project health status, progress, milestones, blockers, team workload analysis, and daily priority actions.
- Delivers project status reports on a scheduled cron or on-demand, with options for Telegram/Discord alerts.
- Customizable thresholds, project selection, team analysis, and delivery channels.
summary: Project status board — compile daily status from tasks, calendar, and team updates into one dashboard. Daily cron or on-demand.
